what: The circular text ring (a line of text such as ‹FOLLOW ON …› around a badge) always rotates at 20° per second, speeds up to 60° per second when you hover the badge and eases back to 20° on release — each frame the speed follows the target by 1 − e^(−3.5·dt), so it changes smoothly over a bit more than a second.

options.speed: Idle rotation per second (°/s), default 20 — negative runs backward
options.hover: Angle turned per second when hovered (°/s), default 60
options.ease: Rate at which speed follows the target (1/s), default 3.5 — higher changes faster
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Rotating child (text-ring svg). If absent, the whole element rotates

use: Icon
note: Keyboard focus speeds it up just like hovering. With reduced motion it doesn’t spin

from.where: shared.js badge text ring (.sr-badge__ring — normally 20°/s, 60°/s on badge hover, follows with 1 − e^(−3.5·dt), stops on zoomed screens). Original social badge rAF as is
All pages: the RESERVE text ring on the bottom-right reserve button (original gsap rotation 360 10s linear repeat −1, on mouseenter it switches immediately to one turn in 5s from the current angle)
